fences.text: A small bunch of white chrysanthemums laid on a weathered wooden rail on a quiet hilltop in Setana, southwestern Hokkaido, at dusk in late spring, facing out over the forested hills toward the Sea of Japan, the last violet-orange light lying along the horizon and the valleys already in shade, No snow anywhere, no frost, no ice, no winter. The rail and flowers are the only objects in the foreground. Dim in the valley but NOT pure black, the flowers and the sea stay clearly readable. Profound respectful stillness, gentle warm and cool tones. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Documentary style. 16:9 aspect ratio. Generate 1 image.
